title: Probabilistic and approximate universal quantum purification machines
summary: We study the task of lifting arbitrary quantum states and channels to purifications and Stinespring dilations, respectively, in both the probabilistic exact and deterministic approximate settings. We formalize this task through a general framework of quantum purification machines that, given a finite number of copies or uses of a black-box input, aim to output a corresponding purification or Stinespring dilation.
